    <h1>I take AI from research to <span class="hl">production</span>.</h1>
    <p><strong>Hi, I'm Sabrine.</strong> An applied mathematics engineer by training, I've spent 10 years taking machine learning to production: at EDF, where I was tech lead, then at SAUR on water networks, where I contributed to a patent on leak prediction.</p>
    <p>In 2024 I chose to bring this to the brain: EEG signal quality with a biosignals startup, a Master's in computational neuroscience at CentraleSupélec, then CEA, where I work on multimodal brain imaging (MEG, fMRI, structural MRI), including upstream work for a brain–computer interface application in stroke. Rigorous enough for research, robust enough for a product.</p>
    <p>Along the way, I teach, write, and help open the door for more women in tech.</p>
